egin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-14

Suppose $(M,g)$ is a Riemannian manifold, and let $\operatorname {div}$ and $\Delta $ be the divergence and Laplace operators defined on pages 32--33.

  1. Show that for every vector field $X \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$, $\operatorname {div} X$ can be written in terms of the total covariant derivative as $\operatorname {div}\, X = \operatorname {tr}( abla X)$, and that if $X = X^i E_i$ in terms of some local frame, then $\operatorname {div}\, X = X^i_{;i}$. [Hint: Show that it suffices to prove the formulas at the origin in normal coordinates.]

  2. Show that the Laplace operator acting on a smooth function $u$ can be expressed as

    \[ \Delta u = \operatorname {tr}_g( abla ^2 u), \]

    and in terms of any local frame,

    \[ \Delta u = g^{ij}u_{;ij} = u_{;i}^{\ i}. \]

(Used on pp. 218, 256, 333.) \end{exercise}
